verdict.rationale: Daily's own documented trigger-action mechanism is narrow: the `start_cloud_recording` token property starts a recording automatically when a token holder joins. Server-side event webhooks (participant joins, recordings complete, incoming dial-in calls) are developer building blocks, because the routing logic has to be written on the user's own server, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general user-definable rules engine (event → condition → action), configurable automation beyond the single recording trigger, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: To start recording automatically when a token holder joins, use the [`start_cloud_recording`](https://docs.daily.co/reference/rest-api/meeting-tokens/create-meeting-token#body-properties-start-cloud-recording) token property.
